title: Great product design and well worth the cost
text:
Great product design and well worth the cost. I lived in Japan for three years and when I saw this container and I saw the brand, I knew it was a quality product as I had purchased this brand before while living in Japan.
I read the reviews and despite others saying the container should be modified because the bags of rice in the USA are 5lbs and in Asia they aren't, I bought it anyway because it's a good brand and the ounce difference wasn't a big deal as I would use 2-3 cups of uncooked rice every time I made rice.
However when I was ready to fill the container I wasn't making rice so I thought the leftover rice could be put into a smaller container, but that wasn't nescessarry.
As the container filled up, I put the lid on and continued to add the remainder of the rice thru the pour spout and tapped the container on my counter a few times and to my surprise, it took the full 5 lbs easily with room to spare.
i would think this container would be great to store flour, sugar, beans, cereal and so much more.
And I doubt the quality of this brand could be found in a dollar store item, as they have dollar stores in Japan where most of the the items cost 100 yen and I shopped there regularly and they did have quality items but to me this brand is more like a mix of our brands Rubbermaid and Tupperware.
